Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 CURSOR cbatchNote_cur(pc_batchID VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT note_id
 FROM batch_inputs
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND batch_id = pc_batchID; 

 l_sql VARCHAR2(2000);
 ln_noteID NUMBER; 
 lc_batchID VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :rgt_tubes.batch_id is null
 then
 show_error('0908');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 lc_batchID := :rgt_tubes.batch_id;
 
 l_sql := 'UPDATE batch_inputs ' 
 || ' SET note_id = LN$NoteID ' 
 || ' WHERE chapter_id = ''' || :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID || ''''
 || ' AND batch_id = ''' || lc_batchID || '''';
 

 OPEN cbatchNote_cur(lc_batchID);
 FETCH cbatchNote_cur INTO ln_noteID;
 CLOSE cbatchNote_cur;
 
 CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES(pl_notes_for => 'CB_ID', 
 pl_value => 'Checkin Batch ID - ' || lc_batchID, 
 pl_sql => l_sql, 
 pl_note_id => ln_noteID);
 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_for_notes (pl_notes_for VARCHAR2, pl_value VARCHAR2, pl_sql VARCHAR2, pl_note_id VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_notes_for', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_notes_for);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_value', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_value);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_sql', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_sql);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_note_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_note_id);


 
 call_form( lower('GEWNOTES') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_BATCH_ID_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct ru.batch_id, substr(to_char(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,ru.tube_check_in_date),'MM-DD-YY'),1,8) from rgt_tubes ru where ru.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and ru.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and (trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time( :GLOBAL.chapter_id,ru.tube_check_in_date)) = :control_block.checkin_date or :control_block.checkin_date is null) order by 2 desc ,ru.batch_id desc

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CHECKIN_DAT_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct substr(to_char(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,tube_check_in_date),'mm-dd-yy'),1,8) , trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,tube_check_in_date)) from rgt_tubes where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id order by 1 desc /* selecting date twice - one for displaying in mm-dd-yy format and the other for returning the actual value minus the date format*/

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLK_PROFILE_SETID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select profile_set_id, 
 decode(profile_type,
 'P', 'Primary',
 'A', 'Adhoc',
 'S', 'Secondary',
 null) profile_desc, 
 term_date
from rgt_contract_profile 
where contract_id = :CONTROL_BLOCK.CONTRACT_ID 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,sysdate) = 'Y'
ORDER BY TRANSLATE(profile_type, 'PAS', '123'), PROFILE_SET_ID

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
